name: When should I consider a roof assessment before selling my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a roof assessment before selling my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a roof assessment before selling your home to proactively address any potential issues that could arise during a buyer's inspection. Identifying and repairing problems beforehand can prevent delays in the sale process or last-minute price negotiations. A clean bill of health for your roof can also be a strong selling point for potential buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assess your roof before selling to address potential issues, prevent delays, and make it a selling point for buyers.
